title: tephrosia dasyphylla subsp. butayei
intro: Tephrosia dasyphylla subsp. butayei, commonly known as Butaye's horsefly, is a plant species in the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia dasyphylla subsp. butayei include wound healing, antidiabetic, and antiparasitic activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is required to fully understand the extent of its bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
